design_purpose.patch_metres: Broad thirteen-metre masses group complementary silhouettes rather than isolated dots.
design_purpose.patch_low: Noise value where sparse edges begin filling.
design_purpose.patch_high: Noise value where living patch hearts become full.
design_purpose.shore_width_m: Retain the seven-metre actual dry-bank band.
design_purpose.max_bank_rise_m: Only banks within three metres of actual lake height receive wetland planting.
design_purpose.tall_band_m: Curving rushes frame the inner four metres of dry bank.
design_purpose.sparse_coverage: Low spreading leaves connect 68 percent of eligible open-patch roots.
design_purpose.dense_coverage: 94 percent of supported roots in patch hearts form a living mass.
design_purpose.rush_share: 24 percent of tall-eligible roots carry curving rush fans; the rest retain lower sightlines.
design_purpose.fern_share: Broad ferns form the upper 23 percent of role selections in non-passage growth.
design_purpose.root_share: Rare 2.5 percent root accents in dense hearts.
design_purpose.passage_frequency_scale: Slower seeded noise makes winding continuous openings among living masses.
design_purpose.passage_threshold: Narrow near-zero band leaves readable passages without creating a path or terrain rule.
design_purpose.passage_coverage: Only 24 percent low cover in passages.
design_purpose.passage_scale: Smaller leaves in passages keep the foreground open.
design_purpose.minimum_scale: Smallest ordinary full patch; border roots may shrink further to stay chunk-local.
design_purpose.root_jitter_m: Up to 13 cm off-centre variation breaks lattice rows.
design_purpose.outer_bank_scale: Low patches taper toward existing upland grass.
design_purpose.home_open_radius_m: Keep tall plants outside eleven metres of home centres.
design_purpose.plant_width_m: Conservative maximum width for spatial reservation indexing; actual meshes own their clearance.
design_purpose.support_step_m: At most 35 cm between support probes over the entire footprint.
design_purpose.max_support_rise_m: Allow broad sloping patches but reject abrupt shelves.
design_purpose.max_plane_error_m: Reject uneven support that would float a shallow patch.
design_purpose.root_embed_m: Seat low growing points 4.5 cm into real supported ground.
design_purpose.ground_mix: Stronger local leaf-litter/low-turf blend joins physical leaves and ground.
design_purpose.wind_bend_per_m: Restrained anchored leaf sway; included in actual clearance bounds.
design_purpose.normal_up_mix: Moderate soft leaf lighting without changing global exposure.
design_purpose.backlight: Quiet transmitted leaf light maintains middle-layer readability.
design_purpose.fern_patch_threshold: Ferns bridge low patch edges and taller hearts.
design_purpose.root_patch_threshold: Root accents stay in established growth.
design_purpose.fringe_scale: A low 48-percent crescent fits supported narrow terrace edges where the full patch is rejected.
